# Kaizenly — full site text

Kaizenly is a strict, local-first focus guard for Android, built by Nadeem
Mazhar (Nadeem Dev Apps), a solo developer in Pakistan.

---

## Overview

### A little better, every day.

Kaizenly is a strict focus guard for Android. Pick a duration, pick a bag of
distracting apps, and they stay blocked until the session ends. Leaving early
costs parachutes — and there is no easy way out. That strictness is the point.

No download yet — the app is in development.

### Why Kaizenly?

Three words, one habit. Kai is change, Zen is calm, ly is daily.

- Kai — Change. Small change, on purpose. Not an overhaul — one better session than yesterday.
- Zen — Calm. Focus without noise. The phone goes quiet, the apps go away, the mind settles.
- ly — Daily. Every day, not someday. The streak is the product — five minutes a day lays a block.

Kaizenly is Kaizen, daily — the Japanese idea that small, continuous
improvement compounds into something real.

### Focus — One session. No way out.

Pick a bag, pick a time, slide to start. From that moment the apps in the bag
are blocked — and leaving early costs parachutes.

Bags: three bags, six slots each, all free. A bag is a named set of apps; the
active bag is the one that gets blocked.

Presets — and the wheel: start in one tap with 15 minutes, 45 minutes, or 3
hours. Or spin the wheel: up to three of your own presets, from 1 to 720
minutes. Sessions over 3 hours need at least one parachute on board — and stay
premium-gated past the free 180 minutes.

Hold to extend: hold for three seconds and the session grows by 15 minutes —
up to +60 minutes per session. Extending needs a parachute on board (it is not
consumed). The session can even stretch to the next routine window, capped at
12 hours.

Routine-aware sessions: a session that would end inside a routine window
stretches to the end of that window instead — when a routine is enabled and
you have a parachute. One focus, no gaps.

The block screen: while a session runs, the block screen is the only thing
between you and the apps. It shows the countdown, the end time, and your
parachutes — and after three seconds of idle it rests, dimming to a quiet
clock.

- Essentials stay open — messaging, dialer, camera, alarm, keyboard, in-call.
- Enforcement is real — shade, recents, and the power menu close; floating
  windows are dismissed; a 15-second watchdog and a guardian fallback bring
  the block back even if the process died.
- Up to 3 × 60-second settings passes per session for the things you genuinely
  need.

The floating pill: a small pill floats over everything while a session runs —
time left and parachutes at a glance. Tap it to open the app.

Parachutes: emergency exits that end a block early. A break costs 1; exiting
early costs 1 + 1 per hour left (minimum 2). Earned free by focusing — never
bought.

The 30-minute break: one parachute buys a 30-minute break, as many times as
you need in a session. The clock freezes; the block returns when the break
ends. Enforcement, sound, and Do Not Disturb rest during the break.

Soundscapes: Rain, Waves, White Noise, and City — four sounds generated live
on your device, never streamed, never auto-played. They fade in and out with
the session. All four are free.

Block screen, done right: the countdown, the end time, your parachutes — and a
celebration when you finish. DONE in white tiles, SOS in green when you
bailed. Share the card as a PNG; the done pill is the only way out.

Boot restore: restart the phone mid-session and the block comes back. The
watchdog, the guardian fallback, and boot restore mean a session ends when the
timer ends — not when the phone does.

### Routines & streaks — Set it once. Focus on schedule.

Up to three routines — a bag, a time window, days of the week — and Kaizenly
starts the block for you. Routines are free, including each routine using its
own bag.

Routines that start themselves: a routine needs at least one parachute to
enable — the safety net for an automatic block. Overlapping routines ask
before they both fire, and each routine can use its own bag: the bag in hand
is restored when the routine session ends.

The daily streak: one minute a day keeps the streak alive — five minutes on
your very first day. Weeks run Monday to Sunday, and a gentle evening reminder
at 8:30 PM nudges you if today is still empty: “Five minutes of session lay
today's block.”

### The Tower — Your streak, built.

Five minutes of focus a day lays one block. Seven blocks make a floor. The
Tower grows as you do.

Life happens: three reserve blocks sit beside the Tower and are spent
automatically on missed days. Ten days in a row restores one spent reserve, up
to three. And if you reach day one hundred, you will find a surprise.

### Stats — Proof, not promises.

Day, month, and year — every session you finished, in one place. Sessions
under five seconds are not recorded; the rest is all yours.

### Widgets — Focus, from the home screen.

Two widgets, no app-opening required. A preset widget (up to three of your
presets, 1–720 minutes) and a streak widget (the last 28 days, 4 week rows).

### Settings & backup — Yours, the way you like it.

Theme: three cards — Light, Automatic, Dark. A fresh install starts in Light.
Dark is the design anchor: deep green-black surfaces with the vivid green
accent.

Haptics: one global switch. Turn it off and every vibration in the app stops.

Local backup: export a JSON backup and import it back with a confirm step. It
is validated before it is written, and a live session is never carried over.
No drive, no password, no upload.

### Free & Premium — Almost everything is free.

Free, for now (Rs 0):

- All 3 bags with 6 slots each
- 3 routines — each routine its own bag, free
- All 4 soundscapes — Rain, Waves, White Noise, City
- Parachutes earned free by the streak
- The Tower, stats, widgets, and local backup
- Sessions up to 3 hours

Premium (Rs 1,450 one-time, arrives with Play Billing):

- Sessions up to 12 hours — the custom card, 3 to 12 hours
- Silence during sessions — Do Not Disturb while you focus
- Everything in Free, of course

### How to get parachutes — Earn them. Never buy them.

Parachutes are the emergency exits of Kaizenly — and they are earned by
focusing, never sold.

The rule, in full: a qualifying day is a day with at least one session of 30
minutes of actual focus. One qualifying day counts per calendar day, and the
counter is the number of qualifying days in a row.

The first 10 days pay double — because building a habit is the hardest part,
so the start pays more. Day 3 earns +2, and every day after that earns +2
until day 10, which pays +6 with its bonus. After day 10, each day earns +1,
with a +5 bonus at day 20.

A missed day resets the streak to 0. Tower reserve blocks do not save it —
the parachute streak has no reserves. The counter is capped at 99.

Reward table:

- Day 3 — +2 — total 2
- Day 6 — +2 / day — total 8
- Day 10 — +6, bonus day — total 20
- Day 15 — +1 / day — total 25
- Day 20 — +6, bonus day — total 35
- Day 30 — +1 / day — total 45

Parachutes are spent on breaks (1 per 30-minute break) and on exiting early
(1 + 1 per hour left, minimum 2). Holding to extend and starting a session
over 3 hours need one on board — but do not consume it.

### FAQ — Kaizenly, answered.

Q: What is Kaizenly?
A: Kaizenly is a strict focus guard for Android. You pick a duration and a
bag — a named set of distracting apps — and every app in the active bag is
blocked until the session ends. Leaving early costs parachutes, and there is
no easy way out: that strictness is the point. All three bags, all six slots
per bag, routines, and soundscapes are free. The only premium features are
sessions up to 12 hours and silence during sessions.

Q: How much does Kaizenly cost?
A: Everything is free to use right now. Bags, routines, soundscapes, and
parachutes are all free in this version. Premium — sessions up to 12 hours
(custom card) and silence / Do Not Disturb during sessions — is Rs 1,450
one-time and arrives with Play Billing. There is no purchase in the app today.

Q: How do I get parachutes?
A: Parachutes are earned, never bought. Focus for at least 30 minutes of
actual focus in a day and that day counts toward your parachute streak. The
first 10 days pay double: day 3 earns +2, and by day 10 you have earned 20.
After day 10 you earn +1 a day, with a +5 bonus at day 20. A missed day resets
the streak to 0 — even if a Tower reserve saves your Tower streak.

Q: What happens if I miss a day?
A: Two different streaks, two different rules. The Tower has 3 reserve blocks:
a missed day spends one automatically, and 10 days in a row restores one. The
parachute streak has no reserves — a missed day resets it to 0, even if a
Tower reserve saved the Tower.

Q: What if I open a blocked app during a session?
A: It bounces straight back. The accessibility service guards the screen: the
notification shade closes, recents close, the power menu closes, and floating
windows are dismissed. A 15-second watchdog and a guardian fallback bring the
block back even if the process died, and the block survives a reboot.

Q: Can I take a break during a session?
A: Yes — a 30-minute break, for 1 parachute, as many times as you need in a
session. The clock freezes while you are on break and the block returns when
the break ends. During a break, enforcement, the overlay, Do Not Disturb, and
sound are all off.

Q: Does Kaizenly store my data anywhere?
A: No. Kaizenly is local-first: sessions live in a local database on your
device, and bags, routines, and settings live in on-device preferences. There
is no Kaizenly account, no sign-up, and no server that receives your data.
The app opts out of automatic cloud backup, so a fresh install starts empty
and uninstalling wipes its local data. You can export and import a local JSON
backup yourself.

Q: Which apps stay open during a session?
A: The essentials stay open: messaging, the dialer, the camera, the alarm,
the keyboard, and in-call screens. Everything in the active bag is blocked —
everything else is yours.

Q: What is the Tower?
A: The Tower is your streak, built. Five minutes of focus a day lays one
block; seven blocks make a floor. Three reserve blocks sit beside it and are
spent automatically on missed days, and ten days in a row restores one spent
reserve. Reach day one hundred and you will find a surprise.

Q: Can I use Kaizenly in the dark?
A: Yes. Kaizenly has Light, Automatic, and Dark themes. A fresh install starts
in Light, and the toggle is in Settings. The dark theme is the design anchor —
deep green-black surfaces with the vivid green accent.

### Your focus belongs to you.

Kaizenly has no account, no sign-up, and no server. Your sessions live in a
local database on your device; your bags, routines, and settings live in
on-device preferences. The app opts out of automatic cloud backup — a fresh
install starts empty, and uninstalling wipes its local data. Your focus data
is yours, and it stays where it was made.

No account. No sign-up. No server. No trackers. Local backup, yours to keep.

and it is built the way he builds everything: local-first, strict where it

## Privacy Policy

Kaizenly is a strict focus guard, and a private one. This policy explains
what it collects — almost nothing — and where your data lives.

### What Kaizenly collects

Almost nothing. Kaizenly stores your sessions in a local database on your
device, and bags, routines, and settings in on-device preferences. It does not
collect your name, email, contacts, location, or the contents of your apps.
There is no Kaizenly account and no sign-up.

### Blocked-app information

Kaizenly keeps a local list of the apps you choose to block, and records when
they are blocked. That information stays on your device; it is never sent
anywhere. Android's usage-access and accessibility permissions are used only
to detect and block apps during a session.

### What stays on your device

Everything. Sessions, bags, routines, settings, your streak and Tower
progress, and your parachutes are all stored locally. On Android the app opts
out of automatic cloud backup (allowBackup=false), so a fresh install starts
empty and uninstalling the app wipes its local data. There is no analytics, no
advertising, no tracking, and no third-party code that sends data anywhere.

### Backup

You can export a JSON backup of your data yourself, and import it back.
Kaizenly does not upload your data anywhere, and it does not store any backup
on a server. Your backup file is yours — keep it safe, since anyone with the
file can read what is in it.

### Premium purchases

Premium features, when they go live, will be sold through Google Play Billing.
Kaizenly does not receive your card number, bank details, or any other payment
information; payments are handled entirely by Google Play.

### Permissions

Kaizenly needs usage access, the accessibility service, device admin, and the
overlay permission to block apps. Those permissions are used only for
blocking, and only while you have a session or routine running. You can revoke
them at any time in your phone's settings; blocking may stop working,
including sessions already in progress.

### Children

Kaizenly does not collect any personal data, and no data is shared with third
parties. The app has no ads, no account, and no in-app communication with
other people.

### Changes to this policy

This policy may be updated from time to time. The version on this page is
always the current one.

### Contact

Questions about this policy? Email nadeem.devapps@gmail.com.

## Terms of Use

Kaizenly is a strict focus guard, provided as-is. Its strictness is the point.

### Acceptance

By installing and using Kaizenly, you agree to these terms. If you do not
agree with any part of them, please do not use the app.

### What Kaizenly does

Kaizenly blocks distracting apps behind a timed focus session. You pick a
duration and a bag — a named set of apps — and every app in the active bag is
blocked until the session ends. Sessions are designed to be hard to break:
leaving early costs a parachute, and a 30-minute break is available during
longer sessions.

### Local-first, no Kaizenly account

Kaizenly stores your sessions in a local database on your device, and bags,
routines, and settings in on-device preferences. There is no Kaizenly account
and no sign-up, and Kaizenly operates no server that receives your data. On
Android the app opts out of automatic cloud backup (allowBackup=false), so a
fresh install starts empty and uninstalling the app wipes its local data.

### Permissions

Blocking needs sensitive permissions: usage access, the accessibility service,
device admin, and the overlay permission. You grant each of them yourself, and
you can revoke them at any time in your phone's settings. Revoking them may
stop blocking from working, including sessions already in progress.

### Premium

Some features, such as custom session durations, are premium and will be sold
through Google Play Billing when they go live. Purchases and refunds will
follow Google Play's terms.

### Acceptable use

Use Kaizenly for lawful personal focus tracking only. You may not use the app
to record, conceal, or facilitate anything illegal.

### Provided as-is

Kaizenly is provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any
kind, express or implied, including any implied warranty of fitness for a
particular purpose. To the extent permitted by law, the developer is not
liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of the app, including a
missed block or a lost streak.

### Stopping use

You can stop using Kaizenly at any time. Uninstalling the app deletes its
local data from the device. If device admin is enabled, turn it off in the app
first, or remove it from your phone's device admin settings before
uninstalling.

### Changes to these terms

These terms may be updated from time to time. The version on this page is
always the current one.

### Contact

Questions about these terms? Email nadeem.devapps@gmail.com.
